text_block_list.text:
I was bitterly disappointed after my last 
race, but today, I will definitely show 
you I can win.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:

everything within our power.
choice_data_list:

ourselves up one last time!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. That really got me fired up 
again.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It is almost the appointed time. —Auf 
geht's!
